# libusb corresponding source

Unmodified libusb 1.0.30 source from https://github.com/libusb/libusb/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.30.tar.gz . Included for the dynamically linked macOS library; it is not executed by the app. Keep this source archive alongside distributed Mac builds.

SHA-256: `2ae28adb0bb9558c86135c4e1c11b320b0805461e207a64a6e520a114094bf07`

License: LGPL-2.1-or-later; see `core/LIBUSB-LICENSE.txt` and `core/TRANSPORT-NOTES.md`. Build script checks that the linked library matches this version.
